title: Extracted Astronomical Rule Schema
description: JSON Schema for astronomical rules extracted from classical mathematical astronomy treatises before parsing and validation

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the astronomical rule (e.g., SUR-0042, DRK-0127)

text.description: The full text of the extracted astronomical rule in transliterated Sanskrit (IAST)

treatise.description: Name of the source classical mathematical astronomy treatise (e.g., Sūryasiddhānta, Dṛggaṇita)

chapter.description: Chapter or section number in the treatise

verse.description: Verse reference or line number in the ancient text

sanskrit_iast.description: Sanskrit text in IAST (International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration) for standardized representation

english_translation.description: English translation of the astronomical rule

parameters.description: Astronomical parameters mentioned in the rule with their mathematical decodings

name.description: Parameter name in the classical rule

type.description: Type of astronomical or mathematical parameter

decoding.description: How to decode or interpret this parameter in modern mathematical notation

interpretation_judgments.description: Interpretive notes and mathematical judgments about the rule

ambiguities.description: Any ambiguous phrases or passages in the ancient text

modernization_notes.description: Notes on how this rule relates to modern mathematical and astronomical methods

confidence_level.description: Confidence in the interpretation of the classical rule

source_file.description: PDF filename or document identifier from which this rule was extracted

source_page.description: Page number in the source document

extraction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this rule was extracted from the classical source

extraction_method.description: How the rule was extracted from the ancient text source

ocr_confidence.description: OCR confidence score if applicable for classical manuscript extraction

status.description: Current review status of the extracted rule

reviewer.description: Name of the expert reviewer validating the rule extraction

comments.description: Any review comments or feedback from the expert assessor
